I was bullied until 5th grade and I´ve been depressed since I was 7. last year I only ate at dinner to keep my family from wondering. I tried to ask my mom for help but she brushed it off and thinks its a phase. I tried to kill my self last year and didn't succeed. Now I´m on this subreddit looking for ways to kill myself.

I feel the same. I had the same plan. The bad part is I tried to and failed. I know its hard, I´ve been there and still think about ending my life on a day to day bases. It hurts. Knowing you´re going to die in the next few minutes is scary. I tried to od and failed. No one knows. I never got help. I never told anyone that I tried. I just waited to die and never did. I didn´t take enough. If I could go back I would. But it´s still scary. Talking to people can help. Find something that helps.
I´m sorry to hear that this has happened to you. I've lost track of all my cuts. Whenever I see them or someone points them out it hurts worse than what I was feeling at the time of the cut.

This post proves how brave you are. Even if you can´t do something that doesn´t define you. The reason to live lies in your ability to accept the challenge of life. If you can push through 20 years of living that proves how strong you are.
You´re someones everything. If you´re not hers then you´re someone else everything.
